== Composed official source and chronology ==
Four documented image layouts are listed in supported source order. Repository dates identify preserved full-face copies; the archive capture and printed edition identify partial-sheet occurrences. Exact first publication days of the partials remain unknown.
* '''Original full face''' ([[Yavin 4: Massassi War Room (V)]]): preserved in [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 the first Holotable repository import, 8 July 2018]. No errata mark.
* '''Errata 1, earlier partial''' ([[Yavin 4: Massassi War Room (V) (Errata)]]): present in the complete official PDF archived at 2021-10-05T19:21:57Z. No errata mark.<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-8-archive-2021-10-05-pages-1-7-extract.pdf|Official Set 8 PDF archived 5 October 2021, lossless page extract]], original page 7 (extract page 2).</ref>
* '''Errata 2, current full face''' ([[Yavin 4: Massassi War Room (V) (Errata 2)]]): [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/44c7bc5c258703260424a3793cd55f0221d672e4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/hires/yavin4massassiwarroom.png source PNG] was authored and committed 2022-07-10T17:26:49Z; the pixel-identical [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 GIF copy] was committed 19:39:59Z that UTC day. Both images have identical complete RGB pixels and dimensions. No errata mark. The full-face state retains the supported <code>208_24</code> mapping.
* '''Errata 3, later partial''' ([[Yavin 4: Massassi War Room (V) (Errata 3)]]): June 2023 sheet edition. No errata mark. The Set 8 badge is larger, and type/title/game-text placement differs from the earlier partial; these are real layout changes rather than JPEG encoding noise.<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-8-June-2023.pdf|Official Set 8 PDF, June 2023 edition]], page 7.</ref>
All four show the same game-text words. The absent marks on the three later image ordinals are recorded in [[Players Committee transcription errors]]. [[File:V8-L-yavin4massassiwarroom-Set8-2021-2023-partial-comparison.png|thumb|center|300px|Earlier and later published partial layouts.]]

Original page7 is raster. Its complete recorded location region is retained; the source is losslessly rotated for landscape display. No artwork is filled into the published cutout. No executable ID is assigned to either partial. Existing supported mapping remains on the moved current full-face article. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]],13 November 2026 (UTC).
